messages.content: build simple calculator using html css javascript

/* File: style.css */ * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; } body { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 100vh; background: #0f172a; } .calculator { border-radius: 16px; background: #1e293b; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); width: 320px; } .calculator-screen { width: 100%; height: 60px; border: none; background-color: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; text-align: right; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 2rem; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; } .calculator-keys { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); grid-gap: 12px; } button { height: 50px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background-color: #334155; color: #f8fafc; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } button:hover { background-color: #475569; } button:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .operator { background-color: #3b82f6; } .operator:hover { background-color: #2563eb; } .equal-sign { background-color: #10b981; grid-column: span 2; } .equal-sign:hover { background-color: #059669; } // File: script.js const screen = document.getElementById('screen'); function appendCharacter(char) { screen.value += char; } function clearScreen() { screen.value = ''; } function deleteLast() { screen.value = screen.value.slice(0, -1); } function calculateResult() { try { if (screen.value === '') return; // Percent operation adjust kar rahe hain let expression = screen.value.replace(/%/g, '/100'); let result = Function(`'use strict'; return (${expression})`)(); if (isNaN(result) || !isFinite(result)) { screen.value = 'Error'; } else { screen.value = result; } } catch (error) { screen.value = 'Error'; } } // Keyboard shortcuts ka support document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { const key = event.key; if (!isNaN(key) || ['+', '-', '*', '/', '.', '%'].includes(key)) { appendCharacter(key); } else if (key === 'Enter' || key === '=') { calculateResult(); } else if (key === 'Backspace') { deleteLast(); } else if (key === 'Escape') { clearScreen(); } });
